invariants.title: Terra on the left, the jester on the right
invariants.rule: Terra is on the LEFT of the screen and the jester on the RIGHT, for the whole shot.
invariants.why: one line of action for the whole film: every camera stands east of the line between them, so a swap of sides would read as a jump

invariants.title: They face each other
invariants.rule: Terra faces screen-right (toward him); the jester faces screen-left (toward her), as the set's frames draw them.
invariants.why: the duel's frames had them mirrored (set_test.py read the sheets' turnaround names the wrong way round until 2026-10-05) - a take must keep the facing its frames give

invariants.title: He has something that glows
invariants.rule: The jester waits across the clearing swinging something that glows like a coal on a chain - the pendant, before she knows it is hers.

invariants.title: Length
invariants.why: the cut is timed to the story beats

flair.title: Seed
flair.note: free - the takes differ by seed

flair.title: Timing inside the shot
flair.note: the beats may land a few frames early or late

flair.title: Sound
flair.note: H3's own: wind in the trees, her footsteps on dry leaves, the faint tinkle of a chain, a soft giggle.

title: the thief
beat: She arrives; he is waiting for her with something that glows. Cuts to her face (020). (shot 1 of 20, before 020)
build: frames first in the clearing set (set_film.py frames), H3 between the set's two frames (set_film.py takes) - the camera, the marks and the facing come from the set
